citation.authors: Miyamoto N, Ishihara K, Oshima T, Kawai M et al
citation.journal: Medicine and Science in Sports and Exercise

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.design: Double-blind randomised placebo-controlled trial, 10 g collagen peptide daily for 16 weeks
record.finding: Calf muscle and Achilles tendon stiffness rose and rate of torque development rose; tendon and muscle size and maximal strength did not change.
record.note: Healthy tendons, not tendon injury. It tests a stiffness measure, not repair or pain.
